name: @teactjs/core
description: Teact framework core — createBot, hooks, router, and more

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --format esm --target bun --external react --external react/jsx-runtime --external react/jsx-dev-runtime --external react-reconciler --external i18next --external react-i18next --external @teactjs/ui && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist --declaration --project tsconfig.build.json && bun ../../scripts/fix-dts.ts
